translator.evidence: Original zh-HK (Hong Kong Traditional Chinese) difference catalog: 21 regional overrides drafted over Traditional Chinese for Taiwan (zh-TW) for Hong Kong terminology (用戶, 智能體, 互聯網, 項目, 點擊, 發送, 相片). Every other message resolves through the declared parent. Overrides keep the DEFAULT_STRINGS key order, exact placeholders, plural categories and ICU syntax. No upstream translated text was copied. This is AI-assisted project localization; no human or native-speaker translator claim is made. Bounded 2026-10-21 AI-assisted independent review checked ten foundation messages for engine loading, context loss, software rendering, list fallback, data limits, scripts and placeholders. Reviewed corrections were applied before this catalog snapshot. This increment does not claim a full-catalog re-review or human/native-speaker qualification. Bounded 2026-10-21 AI-assisted enrollment of thirty-three map control, scale, drawing, vertex-edit and export messages: this catalog inherits zh-TW without new regional overrides. Exact values and placeholders were checked against the prepared bounded inputs. This increment does not claim full-catalog, human or native-speaker review.
